note: US carrier roaming for the destination, from each carrier's own pages. Plan rules vary: confirm your plan with your carrier.

T-Mobile.headline: Included on most postpaid plans
T-Mobile.detail: Calls and texts are free in Mexico. High-speed data is included (5 to 30 GB depending on your plan), then slower speeds. Prepaid plans were not checked.
T-Mobile.pass: International Pass: $50 for 10 days (15 GB) or $75 for 30 days (30 GB)
T-Mobile.caution: T-Mobile's pages disagree on some plan limits, so check your plan in the T-Life app.

Verizon.headline: TravelPass: $6 a day in Mexico
Verizon.detail: 5 GB of high-speed data per day, then slower speeds. You pay only for days you use your phone. Some Unlimited plans may include Mexico at no extra charge.
Verizon.caution: Verizon's pages disagree on whether Mexico is free on Unlimited plans. Check My Verizon for your plan.

AT&T.headline: Included on domestic unlimited plans
AT&T.detail: Talk, text and data in Mexico are included on AT&T unlimited plans, but speeds may be slow. Other plans pay by day or by use.
AT&T.pass: International Day Pass: $12/day, charged only on days you use it
AT&T.caution: I could not confirm the Mexico rules for every AT&T plan. Check your plan with AT&T.
